response.sql: SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code, si.phasefactor AS phase, AVG(s.scancount) AS avg_scancount, AVG(s.pressratio) AS avg_pressratio FROM scans s JOIN sites si ON s.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE s.scancount >= 11 GROUP BY s.zoneref, si.phasefactor ORDER BY (AVG(s.pressratio) IS NULL), AVG(s.pressratio) DESC LIMIT 10
